source.title: Shinners & Mahler's Illustrated Flora of North Central Texas
source.authors: Diggs, G. M. Jr.; Lipscomb, B. L.; O'Kennon, R. J.
source.original_treatment_name: Colubrina texensis (Torr. & A. Gray) A. Gray

morphology_documented.leaves: Small ovate blades with thinly tomentose lower surfaces, 1-nerved
morphology_documented.flowers: Yellow-green ca. 5–6 mm across on condensed spur shoots, solitary axillary but clustered in appearance; ovary 3-celled
morphology_documented.fruit: Drupe-like stony fruit becoming late-dehiscent and capsule-like

source_scope_note: Genus/key traits explicitly identified; modern secondary evidence separately cited; no unsupported species characters inferred.
unresolved_taxonomy_or_source_notes: 1999 treatment mentions Burnet and Brown counties; separate from Hays BONAP nativity
preservation: Additive file; existing species records, photographs, credits and galleries unchanged
